title: Keyboard shortcuts
description:
Match key presses against an accelerator table.

```
Ctrl+S        -> ID_FILE_SAVE
Ctrl+Shift+S  -> ID_FILE_SAVE_AS
F5            -> ID_RUN
Ctrl+Q        -> nothing
```
hints: `TranslateAcceleratorW` in the message loop does this for you with a table from the resource file.
requirements: Entries hold a virtual key, a set of modifiers and a command id, like `ACCEL`.
A press matches only with exactly the same modifiers.
Refuse a table with two entries for the same keys.
stretch: Show the shortcut text next to each menu item (`"Save\tCtrl+S"`).
